articles.title: Ethereum scaling project MegaETH slashes staff by 20% as it pursues AI business

articles.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
articles.snippet: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $70,000 as Dollar Index hits 19-month high
articles.snippet: The crypto market selloff gathered pace early Friday. Bitcoin dropped below $70,000 and ether traded below $2,000, triggering large liquidations in futures market.

articles.title: Bitcoin falls to four-month low near $62K as crypto selloff deepens
articles.snippet: The global cryptocurrency market capitalization fell 4% to $2.26 trillion over 24 hours, while Ether and Solana posted double-digit weekly losses.

articles.title: MegaETH parent cuts 20% of staff amid restructuring, AI push
articles.snippet: MegaETH co-founder Shuyao Kong said the restructuring affected employees who helped build the project’s blockchain, wallet and ecosystem.
